crafts.title_en: Photographic artwork over the whole body
crafts.desc_en: Gradients, photos and multi-colour logos in one pass. Silicone takes a surface primer first, so the print holds through washing and daily handling.
crafts.desc_zh: 渐变、照片、多色 logo 一次印满整只杯。硅胶表面先做一层处理再印，洗过、日常磕碰都不容易掉色。
crafts.cta_zh: 问 UV 满印的价格

crafts.title_en: 1–3 spot colours, lowest unit cost
crafts.desc_en: The cheapest way to put a one-colour brand mark on a silicone cup. Crisp edges; print area is confirmed per model before sampling.
crafts.desc_zh: 单色 logo 单价最低的做法，字边干净。每款能印多大面积，打样前逐款确认。
